title: VanillaCraft Renewd
description: Just your classic Minecraft, but better and renewed
body:
# ![Little sunset in the modpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6de339473d324e66110f07550668f9bc6952809b.jpeg) Minecraft Renewd
-----------------------------
Modpack that makes the default minecraft gameplay better, but not extremly.
It add some Quality of Life mods, and Optimalization Mods (ofc) and adds some datapacks, resoursepacks and 2 shaders packs

Some of the Mods:
> - **Items Displayed** (by FREEDINNER) - You can display your treasures like music disc or ingots on the display shelf or place them on a block
> - **Supplementaries** (by MehVahdJukaar) - Adds things like globe, flute, helmet display, new signs, slingshot and other.....
> - **Carry On** (by Tschipp) - you can carry your chests in both of your hands for easier transport, you can carry even villagers and other mobs.....
> - **Easy Anvils**
> - **Easy Magic**
> - **Visual Workbench** (by Fuzs) - All of there make it that the items stay in the blocks, so lapis stays in Enchant table, your tools stay in Anvil and items in crafting table are diplayed on top of the crafting table
